council.eureka: Do not confuse momentum with health; V59+ should start with eureka analysis before load.
Use deep plus L4/L5 as the repeated standard proof, but retain standard as a repair fallback.
Pair QCIT/GMUT probes with observable deltas, not claims of external validation.
Anchor public-source claims and keep advisory text separate from verified truth.
Treat the one-node cluster as a scarce runtime and cool it between heavy proofs.
Never publish raw API bank values; use label/fingerprint-only evidence.
Publish forward-only with curated allowlists; leave suite churn unstaged.
Escalate only after readiness, pod health, and restart posture are recorded.
